generator: BEAM generator output layout (https://github.com/mohammadtavakoli78/BEAM, src/beam/main.py at b2da22e)
layout: conversations/<n>/chat.json (chat_trunecated.json when present) and conversations/<n>/probing_questions/<ability>/<ability>.json under GBRAIN_EVALS_D8_SOURCE; conversation d8-<n> is conversations/<n>, n = 1 to 10
note: Hashes only; no D8 text is committed. Until the custodian runs `bun eval/runner/q1/d8-manifest.ts fill --write` on the custody host, `files` is empty and beam-d8 loads with a notice that its bytes are unpinned. Once filled, every file the loader reads must be listed here with a matching SHA-256, and every listed file of a loaded conversation must be present.
